representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape = one high-consequence workflow, high hierarchy, low density. Implementation is a single-screen cutover console for a 12-step/4-phase runbook (screenshots/1280x860.png: left nav groups 阶段一–四 with S1–S12; source/js/data.js:15-296 nests phases→steps). Center execution card is dominant, right inspector + run log are supporting — matches the consequential-flow shape; data is inline with zero network requests (source/js/data.js:1).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen at 1280x860 and 1440x900 puts the actionable step card front-and-center: S1 goal line, 操作指令, 0/2 检查项 checkboxes, and the primary button 确认完成本步骤; header shows 0/12 步 progress. First step is pre-selected as 'ready' in source (source/js/app.js:89-90), so the primary task (walk the flow) is the dominant surface on load.

time_to_understand.evidence: Within seconds the screen conveys what (核心支付库迁移切换, 生产环境 · PAY-PROD · 变更窗口 09-12 01:00–03:00 header chips, index.html:20-24 filled by app.js:318-321), where (S1 highlighted with play icon, later steps show locks), and what next (numbered instructions + check items + primary CTA). Run log pre-seeds orientation lines (app.js:92-96, visible in both screenshots).

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero clicks to reach the primary object: current step is selected at load (app.js:89-90) and all primary actions (check, submit, confirm) live on the one permanent screen; no routes/tabs (index.html:35-42). Sequential locking (app.js:127-131 intercepts out-of-order clicks) is the brief's own zero-mistake semantics rather than navigation overhead; note this also means locked future steps cannot be previewed, a deliberate task-aligned tradeoff.

context_loss.evidence: Single-page app, no navigation away from context: submit auto-advances selection to the next step in the same view (app.js:170-175); irreversible execution and recovery are modals over the current screen with cancel/Escape paths (app.js:513-555, 610-615) and field-level errors shown inline (app.js:503-505); run log and guard counter persist across actions (app.js:99-121).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Five permanent regions, each pulling weight relative to the brief: header (progress + guard counter + restart), step nav (needed for the high-hierarchy object), execution card (primary task), risk/recovery inspector (carries the consequence/recovery seed), run log (zero-mistake audit trail with export/copy). No redundant controls; spacious low-density layout (source/css/app.css:1,101-118) matches shape density=low.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all a11y/type checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Corroborated in source: muted text #8a97a6 on white ≈2.9:1 used for headings/hints/timestamps (source/css/app.css:8,40,216,235); native checkbox inputs visually hidden via position:absolute/opacity:0 shifting focus indication to a sibling restyle (app.css:203,211); 10–11px targets/type (.btn-xs app.css:253, .nav-recov app.css:148-152). Some genuine effort exists (:focus-visible outline app.css:53; aria-labels index.html:36-40; role=alert app.js:360,504; aria-modal dialogs), but the objective receipt is 3 passes vs 4 fails.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass, and both screenshots render cleanly at 1280x860 and 1440x900 with no truncation/collision. However 4 of 7 receipt checks failed (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), each implying concrete remediation work (color, focus handling, control sizes, type scale) — moderate rework signal, not defect-free.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径' is fully implemented: S7/S8/S12 flagged irreversible with typed confirm codes GO-NEWDB / UNFREEZE-OK / RETIRE-OLD plus recovery windows (15min/30min/24h), recovery step lists and consequence text (source/js/data.js:154-171,184-201,276-292); confirmation modal requiring the code before execution (app.js:181-197, 512-525); post-execution recovery wizard with its own checklist + RECOVER code that rolls the step back and re-locks successors (app.js:198-247, 526-545); inspector always shows the recovery path (app.js:474-484, visible as 风险与恢复检查器 in both screenshots).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast=fail: low-contrast muted text (#8a97a6 on white ≈2.9:1) used for section headings, hints, log timestamps (source/css/app.css:8,40)
a11y.focus_order=fail: native checkbox inputs visually hidden with position:absolute/opacity:0, focus indicator relies on sibling restyle (source/css/app.css:203,211)
a11y.target_size=fail: small controls such as 11px log 导出/复制 buttons (source/css/app.css:253)
type.min_projected_size=fail: 10–12px type in nav badges, log list and hints (source/css/app.css:148-152,253,289)

Locked steps are entirely unreadable until reached — out-of-order clicks are intercepted instead of previewed (source/js/app.js:127-131); defensible for the zero-mistake job but blocks pre-execution review of later steps' recovery plans
scores.overall_note: impl-07 is a coherent single-screen cutover console that fits the brief's consequential-flow shape closely: a 12-step, 4-phase payment-DB migration runbook rendered as a wizard (data.js:15-296) with the current step reachable in zero clicks (app.js:89-90), all primary actions on one persistent surface (no context loss), and guardrails (missed-check, out-of-order, wrong confirm code) that directly operationalize the zero-mistake job. The acceptance seed is thoroughly covered: every irreversible step (S7/S8/S12) has a typed confirmation code before execution and a windowed recovery wizard afterwards (app.js:181-247), with recovery paths also surfaced in the always-visible inspector. The initial screen reads quickly at both 1280x860 and 1440x900 with no layout defects (layout.overflow/responsive_collision/text.truncation all pass). The clear weakness is accessibility: the receipt fails a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size, consistent with low-contrast muted text, visually-hidden native checkboxes and 10–11px controls in the CSS, which is also the main driver of the rework signal. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot, and model-judged time_to_understand here is a proxy, not a human measurement.
